title: The finite-energy boundary of a group
description: Finite-energy functions on the Cayley complex of a finitely presented group, and the boundary they give a one-ended group: a function with connected level sides, a compact metric space containing the group with square summable edge lengths, a boundary that is a continuum, paths near boundary points, the action of the group on the boundary as a convergence group with dense orbits, and the dimension and first Čech cohomology of the boundary. The first steps of OpenAI's proof (2026) of the Singer conjecture in dimension four outside the middle degree.

free groups and presentations of groups

for the fourth lesson: the course Continua, arcs and cut points, and covering dimension (Definition 2.1 of Covering dimension and finite trivializing covers)
the course proves every other fact it uses
